title: macOS Web Desktop startup configuration v1
description: Session-only config query parameter. Runtime limits JSON to 8192 UTF-8 bytes and the full query to 32768 characters.

apps.description: Exact allowlist of enabled bundled apps. Omitted enables all; an empty object enables none. Does not automatically launch apps.

homepage.description: Absolute HTTP(S) URL, valid hostname, no credentials, whitespace, controls or backslashes. Runtime uses URL and a stricter 2048 UTF-16-code-unit limit. Default: https://vectorindex.cloud.
